## Texts and drawings (4)

- **E1847** (text, sure): 日下舊聞考 方壶胜境. 1780s (乾隆 敕撰) · j82:12a-13a · S05. https://github.com/kanripo/KR2k0036/blob/master/KR2k0036_082.txt
  > 四宜書屋之東臨池樓宇為方壺勝境上下各五楹南建坊座二其北樓宇為噦鸞殿又北為瓊華樓噦鸞殿東為蕊珠宫宫南船塢後有龍王廟（圓明園册）臣等謹按方壺勝境四十景之一額為皇上御書坊座南額曰芝田日永曰閬苑春深北曰鳯鳴珠樹曰鹿夀靈臺方壺勝境樓宇上額曰宜春殿曰敬勝怠噦鸞殿樓宇上額曰用厥中曰有真賞在瓊華樓額曰潄芳潤及蕊珠宫額皆御書
  East of 四宜書屋 on the water: 方壺勝境, five bays on two floors, with two archways to the south, 噦鸞殿 and 瓊華樓 behind, 蕊珠宫 to the east, a boathouse and a 龍王廟. The note gives each plaque.
- **E2391** (text, likely): 《日下舊聞考》 on 船塢 in 西峯秀色 and 蕊珠宫. 乾隆, 1780s · j82:8a, 12b · S05. https://www.kanripo.org/text/KR2k0036/082
  > 西峯秀色迤東東西船塢各二所 / 噦鸞殿東為蕊珠宫宫南船塢後有龍王廟
  Four boathouses east of 西峰秀色 and one south of 蕊珠宫. YM85 is not 蕊珠宫's dock per the plan note: no text found for it.
- **E0499** (description, sure): 三类 形制, 山墙 红色 (S47 section 3). 2012, citing archive and Qing texts · pp.121-123 · S47. https://www.dpm.org.cn/Uploads/File/2018/06/15/u5b23730ae0e5a.pdf
  S47 sorts the shrines in three types by form and notes that on the album the gable walls of seven of them are painted red, against grey or white on other buildings: 瑞应宫, 太岁坛, the 杏花春馆 earth shrine, the 北远山村 and 涵虚朗鉴 dragon shrines, 广育宫 and 多宝阁. A colour rule usable for the models.
- **E1851** (description, sure): 方壶胜境 南 龙王庙 (S47 section 2.11). 2012, citing archive and Qing texts · p.115; table row 22 · S47. https://www.dpm.org.cn/Uploads/File/2018/06/15/u5b23730ae0e5a.pdf
  South of 蕊珠宫 behind the boat dock, north of 涵虚朗鉴 and close to the five-arch sluice: three bays, hanging gable with ridge and finials, facing south; before 1744 by the album.

**On the plan:** Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 龙王庙. https://artmuseum.princeton.edu/collections/objects/138657
